name: myfit
description: Publicly readable, AI-accessible personal wardrobe system.

scripts.publish:content: pnpm --filter @myfit/domain build && pnpm --filter @myfit/contracts build && pnpm --filter @myfit/operator build && node tools/operator/dist/index.js
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:packages
scripts.validate: pnpm run build && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run validate:json && pnpm run validate:architecture && pnpm run check:secrets
